$n$ options `$p_{ij}$ $r_{ik}$ $c_{jk}$', for $1\le k\le n$. Finally,

be an option
$$\hbox{`$g_t$ $\bigcup\bigl\{r_{il(i_t,j_t)},\;

for every feasible way to assign labels $l(i_t,j_t)$ to the cells of $C_t$.
